title: Jewel Toned Polish Prune Tagine
description: A sweet and chewy Polish dish featuring malt vinegar and prunes, cooked in a tagine and inspired by Ayurvedic rajasic-friendly principles.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large tagine or Dutch oven, combine the prunes, malt vinegar, honey, water, cinnamon, and ginger.
Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat, then cover the tagine and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 30 minutes, then stir in the lemon juice and almond oil.
Continue baking the tagine for an additional 20 minutes, or until the prunes are tender and the sauce has thickened.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the tagine warm, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
